{{Quote|For you, my daughter. May you begin to understand.|A note left in the book by Boba Fett for his daughter, [[Ailyn Vel]]|<ref name="Book" />}}
'''''The Bounty Hunter Code''''' was a guide book for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], created by the famous hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Fett made the book by binding together the latest edition of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' and a manifesto from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Together, these volumes made up ''The Bounty Hunter Code''. The front cover was printed in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic characters]].<ref name="Book" />
